evidence.title: Taskplane README
evidence.locator: What it does; Key features; Installation; Quickstart; Commands; How it works
evidence.finding: Multi-agent orchestration for coding with pi: tasks as PROMPT.md/STATUS.md, dependency waves, git worktree lanes, worker/reviewer/merger/supervisor agents, file mailbox, web dashboard, orch branch and /orch-integrate; Node 22, pi and Git required.

evidence.title: Execution model
evidence.finding: Persistent-context worker loop with fresh context per iteration, review_step inline reviews, STATUS.md as memory, checkpoint commits, .DONE marker, merge to orch branch.

evidence.title: Persistence and resume
evidence.finding: Batch state in .pi/batch-state.json with atomic writes, lane sidecars, STATUS.md and .DONE markers support safe resume.

evidence.title: Merge and conflict resolution
evidence.finding: An LLM merge agent merges lane branches into the orch branch with verification.

evidence.title: task-orchestrator.yaml reference
evidence.locator: Field reference; merge retry policy matrix
evidence.finding: max_lanes 3 default, subprocess spawn mode, assignment strategies, merge model and verify commands, failure policies skip-dependents/stop-wave/stop-all, stall timeout 30 and max_worker_minutes 30, retry matrix, rollback.

evidence.title: Taskplane settings
evidence.finding: Interactive settings TUI; supervisor autonomy interactive/supervised/autonomous with action classes; integration manual/supervised/auto; operator ID for team collision resistance.

evidence.title: Task format
evidence.finding: Task packet with mission, dependencies, file scope, steps, completion criteria, review level, amendments, STATUS.md and .DONE.

evidence.title: Review loop
evidence.finding: Review level 0-3 controls plan and code review via review_step; REVISE feedback addressed inline.

evidence.title: Use tmux for visibility
evidence.finding: Optional tmux sessions per lane for attach; dashboard shows tmux attach commands.

evidence.title: Architecture
evidence.finding: Supervisor steers agents through a file-based mailbox.

evidence.title: Security policy
evidence.finding: Experimental early stage; latest npm release supported; private vulnerability reporting.

evidence.title: Orchestrator engine
evidence.locator: TokenCounts with costUsd line 180; cost aggregation lines 5340-5367
evidence.finding: Engine aggregates per-worker input, output, cache tokens and costUsd across lanes and batches.

evidence.title: Sidecar telemetry
evidence.finding: Worker telemetry (tokens, tool calls, retry state) is read from local sidecar JSONL files written by pi for the dashboard; it is local, not sent to a service.

evidence.title: Dashboard server
evidence.finding: Node HTTP server with SSE for batch state, default port 8099, run by taskplane dashboard.

evidence.title: Supervisor agent
evidence.finding: Supervisor monitors batches, recovers failures and invokes orchestrator commands according to the autonomy level.

evidence.title: MIT License (LICENSE)
evidence.finding: Repository LICENSE is MIT.

evidence.title: GitHub API for HenryLach/taskplane
evidence.finding: Repository has 220 stars, license MIT, last push 2026-10-26.

evidence.title: Taskplane releases
evidence.finding: v0.30.6 (2026-09-07) is the latest release at retrieval; distributed as the npm package taskplane, with no GitHub release assets.

evidence.title: Bounded search: telemetry, webhooks, MCP, containers
evidence.finding: No external telemetry or analytics, no webhook or MCP code; "telemetry" names local worker token data; container/sandbox words appear only in worktree/workspace/settings text, not as isolation.

evidence.title: Bounded search: users, roles, SSO, PR creation
evidence.locator: rg -il "sso|saml|oidc|rbac|presence|pull request|gh pr" extensions bin dashboard
evidence.finding: No SSO, roles, presence or pull request creation; integration is by merging the orch branch into the working branch.

evidence.title: Bounded search: schedules and issue trackers
evidence.finding: No schedule or external tracker integration; tasks are PROMPT.md files.
